source: I'm running late because I couldn't find parking.
target: Parking delayed me. I shall arrive later than intended.

source: Can you bring my charger when you come?
target: Bring my charger when you arrive, if you would.

source: I have to finish this before the end of the day.
target: This must be completed before the day comes to an end.

source: The meeting has been cancelled.
target: The meeting shall no longer take place.

source: I'll grab lunch and be back in twenty minutes.
target: I shall obtain lunch and return in twenty minutes.

source: Please don't share this message with anyone.
target: Share this message with no one. Its contents must remain private.

source: I think I left my wallet in the taxi.
target: I believe my wallet was left behind in the taxi. We must find it.

source: The elevator is out of order, so take the stairs.
target: The elevator has failed. Use the stairs instead.

source: Can you cover for me while I step out?
target: Stand in for me while I am away, if you can.

source: I have too many emails to answer today.
target: Too many messages await my response today.

source: The food is getting cold. Let's eat now.
target: The food grows cold. Let us eat without further delay.

source: I won't be able to attend the party this weekend.
target: I shall be unable to attend the gathering this weekend.

source: Please keep the noise down; the baby is sleeping.
target: Lower the noise. The child is asleep and must not be disturbed.

source: I need to book a table for four people.
target: I must reserve a table for four.

source: The meeting room is on the second floor.
target: The meeting room awaits us on the second floor.

source: I sent the payment, but it hasn't gone through yet.
target: I sent the payment, yet it has not been completed.

source: My cab driver took the wrong turn.
target: The driver has taken the wrong path. We must correct our course.

source: I have a lot to do before I can log off.
target: Much remains to be done before I can disconnect for the day.

source: Let's split the bill equally.
target: Let us divide the bill into equal shares.

source: I need to call my parents this evening.
target: I must speak with my parents this evening.

source: The store is crowded, so let's come back later.
target: The store is filled with people. We shall return when the crowd has diminished.

source: I spilled water on my desk.
target: Water has been spilled across my desk. The disorder must be addressed.

source: Can you send me the address again?
target: Send me the address once more, if you would.

source: I have to cancel my subscription before it renews.
target: I must end the subscription before it renews.

source: Let's leave early to avoid the rush.
target: Let us depart early and avoid the coming rush.
